verdict.rationale: Third-party gateway support is evidenced only by community reports: one says Shopify charges an extra 1% per transaction on third-party payment integrations, and another says enabling Shopify Payments disables the standalone legacy Stripe module. Multi-currency is only implied by Markets' claim of selling to multiple markets with per-market pricing previews, and no evidence explicitly mentions currencies. missing for 10: first-party docs on the third-party gateway catalog and setup, explicit multi-currency charging/settlement documentation, clarity on fee and coexistence limits when using non-Shopify gateways.
